_eligibility_text: The applicant must be a landholding farmer or a farmer group The applicant must have a minimum of 2 hectares (ha) of land in a cluster. > **Note:** - Only one of the holders mentioned in 8-A land records per account is eligible for benefits with the consent of other holders. - A farmer is eligible for assistance for a maximum of one account.
